reviews.text: My husband and I were here 4 years ago and enjoyed it so much, we had to stop by again on our recent trip even though we stayed at a different resort. This is one of our favorite lobby bars for the atmosphere and the drinks. This time we had an awesome bartender Zack who even made me my favorite drink from 4 years ago that’s no longer on menu. We enjoyed his drinks and conversation so much we even went back after dinner for more. The cocktails are sophisticated and the bar is such a great place to sit and chat with the bartenders. Zack is super knowledgeable of cocktails and can make you drinks you’ve never even heard of! If you’re in Scottsdale, whether you stay at Phoenician or not, I highly recommend dropping by for a cocktail or two. The experience made our night!
reviews.author: Jessica Schillo

reviews.text: came here for a quick birthday drink and got the sugar magnolia, it was so good and perfectly balanced. i would’ve stayed for food too because everything sounded amazing, but i had a dinner reservation somewhere else. the bartender was super nice, the view was beautiful, and the ambiance was really nice. i’d definitely come back to get the full experience next time. 🍸✨

If you’re here for a conference it’s a great place to have meetings!

reviews.text: I have no idea why or how this place is rated so highly. The view is good, but not overwhelming (sit outside if possible). We sat, and water quickly arrived. Things went downhill from there. It took about 15 minutes to get our drinks from the time the order was placed. We had queso delivered (which was just OK), and asked for a few more chips. Those were delivered about 20+ minutes later, after telling an additional two servers about the request. We were never asked if we wanted additional drinks, water, or anything else. Took ten plus minutes to get our bill. Seems to be seriously short of staff - I will note that the few staff available were hustling. On a menu note, the place has no beers on tap - despite Arizona's growing craft beer industry. This is just weird for a high-ish end bar.
